info.title: Syntax rules
info.text:
A language has rules for valid code.

Missing punctuation can break those rules.

Read the diagnostic and inspect nearby code.

Challenge: What single character fixes this example?

Add the closing parenthesis after the closing quote.

info.title: Logic can be wrong
info.text:
A program can execute and give a wrong result.

Compare behaviour with the requirement.

Use known inputs to expose the fault.

Challenge: What does the wrong expression give for 6 and 10?

11, because division happens before addition. The correct average is 8.

info.title: Off-by-one errors
info.text:
A loop may run once too often or too little.

Check the start and end conventions.

Array indices must stay within their valid range.

Challenge: Why is index 4 invalid for this list?

A four-item zero-indexed list ends at index 3.

info.title: Faulty initialisation
info.text:
A running total needs an initial value.

Initialise it once before the loop.

Repeated initialisation loses earlier work.

Challenge: Where should total = 0 be moved?

Before the loop, so earlier additions remain in the total.

info.title: Trace the faulty line
info.text:
Change one cause at a time.

Explain how the faulty line affects the result.

A renamed variable alone may not fix the rule.

Challenge: Give the corrected line and a reason.

Use if age >= 12 then. Equality must be included.

info.title: Verify with evidence
info.text:
Retest the input that exposed the error.

Check nearby and previously working cases.

Record expected and actual results.

Challenge: Why check 11 as well as 12?

It verifies that the correction has not started accepting values below the threshold.
